skipped.reason: Handwritten scorer's sheet for New Mexico vs New Mexico State, Albuquerque, 10 Feb '66. Sheet is labeled 'Half 2d' with a 2nd-half-only shot chart, making it ambiguous whether the box score table beneath reflects the full game or only the second half. Additionally, the New Mexico State (right-hand) player rows are largely illegible handwriting (player names and several numeric cells cannot be read with confidence), and some New Mexico rows (De La Porte, Sparholtz, Cleveland, Rose) have blank or partial stat cells. Given the ambiguity in what the totals represent plus illegible digits on the opposing team, transcription was skipped rather than guessed to avoid fabricating values.
